title: Has anyone been to this bathroom in mall world???
content: Its a disgusting public restroom that has sqautty oblong toilets like a sideways oval that for some reason some are made of a cloth like material the inside of the toilet looks non functional with either no drain for your business to flush down or a small weird drain that cant possibly work. The bathroom is always nasty and has either leaking toilets full if someones left behind feces or pee or just disgusting looking in general, or the toilets are occupied. Either way its completely unsanitary looking and its a maze of endless toilets forever also there seems to either be no stall walls or very short walls you can look at the person next to you at and the lighting is always dim and just gives an eerie feeling to.
